condition: When a filled go.Scatter trace (e.g. fill="toself") is plotted with the x-axis rangeslider visible, the fill hover area is computed from the rangeslider's mini-plot. Only a thin strip of the fill responds to hover, and zooming does not fix it.
workaround: Don't enable the rangeslider on figures that rely on hover over filled areas. Another option is to patch the bundled plotly.js so it skips the _fillElement/_polygons assignments when plotinfo.isRangePlot is set.
